item.title: [Photo] Jung Won-oh on 'Real Estate' vs. Oh Se-hoon on 'Health'… Seoul mayoral candidates' pledge competition heats up ([포토] 정원오 ‘부동산’ 대 오세훈 ‘건강’…서울시장 후보 공약 경쟁 본격화)
item.description:
Jung Won-oh, the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for Seoul mayor, and Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party candidate for Seoul mayor, each announced their pledges for the June 3 local elections, kicking off their policy campaigns in earnest. Democratic candidate Jung Won-oh visited the Jangwi redevelopment district in Seongbuk-dong, Seoul on the 29th and unveiled a real estate policy focused on shortening redevelopment project timelines and supplying a large volume of 'substantial housing.' Candidate Jung stated, "We will supply a large number of public housing units at prices and rents that are affordable for non-homeowning middle-class citizens." (정원오 더불어민주당 서울시장 후보와 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보가 각각 6·3 지방선거 공약을 발표하며 본격적인 정책 행보를 시작했다. 정원오 민주당 후보는 29일 서울 성북동 장위재개발지구를 현장방문해 정비사업 기간의 단축과 ‘실속주택’ 대규모 공급을 주요 내용으로 하는 부동산 정책을 발표했다. 정 후보는 “무주택 중산층 서민들도 부담 가능한 분양가와 임대료의 공공주택을 대규모로 공급하겠다”고 말했다.)

People Power Party candidate Oh Se-hoon announced 'Steel Stamina, Vibrant Seoul' as his first pledge. On the 29th, at the Dobong-gu Public Health Center in Seoul, Oh unveiled a public health pledge, declaring the creation of an urban environment where everyone can enjoy a healthy daily life regardless of where they live or their income level, as the top priority for completing quality of life. Candidate Oh emphasized, "Regardless of where you live or what you do, health should not be a goal but part of daily life itself in Seoul," adding, "Reducing health disparities by region and income is a key task for completing the 'Special City of Quality of Life' and enhancing urban competitiveness." Afterward, Oh visited Ssangmun Market in Dobong-gu, Seoul, and the area known as Ssangridangil to meet with citizens. (오세훈 국민의힘 후보는 1호 공약으로 ‘강철 체력, 활력 서울’을 발표했다. 오 후보는 29일 서울 도봉구보건소에서 삶의 질을 완성하기 위한 최우선 과제로 거주 지역이나 소득 수준과 관계없이 누구나 건강한 일상을 누리는 도시 환경을 조성하겠다고 시민 건강공약을 밝혔다. 오 후보는 “어디에 살든, 어떤 일을 하든 건강은 목표가 아니라 서울에서의 일상 그 자체여야 한다”라며 “지역·소득별 건강 격차를 줄이는 것이야말로 ‘삶의 질 특별시’를 완성하고 도시 경쟁력을 높이는 핵심 과제”라고 강조했다. 이후 오 후보는 서울 도봉구 쌍문시장과 일명 쌍리단길을 찾아 시민들을 만났다.)

Photos by Jeong Yong-il and Kim Jeong-hyo, Text by Kim Tae-hyung yongil@hani.co.kr (사진 정용일 김정효 기자, 글 김태형 기자 yongil@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee Orders Review to Allow Use of High Oil Price Subsidies at Gas Stations with Annual Revenue Over 3 Billion Won (이 대통령 “매출 30억 이상 주유소서 고유가 지원금 가능하게” 검토 지시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung reportedly instructed on the 29th that the high oil price relief subsidies be made available for use at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more. (이재명 대통령이 고유가 피해지원금을 ‘연 매출 30억원 이상 주유소’에서도 사용할 수 있도록 검토해보라고 지시한 것으로 29일 알려졌다.)

Chief Presidential Secretary for Public Relations and Communication Lee Gyu-yeon said on KBS Radio that day, "(Yesterday) President Lee asked senior secretaries for their opinions on the restriction of using high oil price relief subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue over 3 billion won. He said, 'Intuitively, citizens see it as a high oil price relief subsidy, so shouldn't they be allowed to at least fill up on gas?' and ordered a review in the direction of easing that restriction." (이규연 청와대 홍보소통수석은 이날 한국방송(KBS) 라디오에서 “전날 (이 대통령이) 수석들에게(연 매출 30억 이상 주유소에서 고유가 피해지원금 사용 제한에 대한) 의견을 들어보자고 했다”며 “‘아무래도 국민들이 직관적으로 받아들이는 것은 고유가 피해 지원금이니까 기름 정도는 넣을 수 있게 해야 되는 거 아니냐’ 해서 그걸 한 번 풀어주는 방향으로 검토해 보라고 (이 대통령이) 지시를 내렸다”고 말했다.)

The government has been providing 'high oil price relief subsidies' since the 27th to alleviate the increased burden on citizens due to the prolonged US-Israel/Iran war. However, it was pointed out that the inability to use these subsidies at gas stations with annual revenue of 3 billion won or more has caused inconvenience. (정부는 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화 탓에 늘어난 국민들의 부담 완화를 위해 오는 27일부터 ‘고유가 피해지원금’을 지급하고 있다. 그런데 연매출 30억원 이상인 주유소에서는 이를 쓸 수 없어 불편하다는 지적이 제기된 바 있다.)

Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk, with no one to back him... Immersed in SNS election campaign 'hitting President Lee' (불러주는 이 없는 장동혁…SNS서 ‘이 대통령 때리기’ 선거전 몰입)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party, is continuing his 'anti-opposition struggle' via social media (SNS). Ahead of the June 3 local elections, as candidates form their own independent election committees in a pattern of 'leader bypassing', he is focusing on 'rear support'—announcing central party pledges and criticizing President Lee Jae-myung through SNS. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 에스엔에스(SNS)로 ‘대여 투쟁’을 이어가고 있다. 6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 후보들이 독자적 선거대책위원회를 구성하는 등 ‘대표 패싱’이 지속되면서 중앙당 공약 발표, 에스엔에스를 통한 이재명 대통령 비판 등 ‘후방 지원’에 몰입하는 모양새다.)

On the morning of the 29th, Leader Jang announced 'four major pledges for regions and livelihoods' at the National Assembly. The pledges included resolving polarization in the housing market between the capital region and provinces, promoting domestic production through tax policies, and building a safety net for small and medium-sized enterprise succession. Floor Leader Song Eon-seok did not attend the announcement. In the afternoon, he held a 'youth daily-life-centered pledge meeting' at a café in Seodaemun-gu, Seoul, listening to 11 pledges proposed by young people. At this meeting, Policy Committee Chair Jung Jeom-sik, who oversees party policy, was absent, prompting Lee Yong-ho, the district committee chair for Seodaemun-gu in Seoul, to ask mid-speech, "Isn't the Policy Committee Chair here?" (장 대표는 29일 오전 국회에서 ‘지역·민생 4대 공약’을 발표했다. △수도권-지방 주택시장 양극화 해소 △국내생산 촉진 세제 △중소기업 승계 안전망 구축 등의 내용이 담겼다. 발표 현장에 송언석 원내대표는 참석하지 않았다. 오후에는 서울 서대문구 한 카페에서 ‘청년 생활밀착형 공약 간담회’를 열고 청년들이 제시하는 11개 공약을 청취했다. 이 간담회에는 당 정책을 총괄하는 정점식 정책위의장이 참석하지 않아 이용호 서울 서대문갑 당협위원장이 발언 도중 “정책위의장님 안 오셨어요?”라고 묻기도 했다.)

Leader Jang has been pouring out remarks targeting President Lee and Democratic Party of Korea candidates via SNS platforms like Facebook and X (formerly Twitter). On this day, he wrote on Facebook, "A Japanese oil tanker carrying crude oil is heading toward Japan through the Hormuz Strait without paying transit fees. Where is diplomacy genius President Lee Jae-myung and what is he doing?" He followed up with a post directed at the president, saying, "During his time in the opposition, he constantly obstructed foreign policy at every turn, but now that he's president, he's completely changed his tune. Stop the anti-America, pro-China stance and look back at 'Yesterday's Lee' first." (장 대표는 페이스북과 X(엑스) 등 에스엔에스를 통해 이 대통령과 더불어민주당 후보를 겨냥한 발언을 쏟아내고 있다. 그는 이날 페이스북에 “원유를 실은 일본 유조선이 호르무즈 해협을 통행료 없이 통과해 일본을 향하고 있다”며 “외교 천재 이재명 대통령은 어디서 뭘 하시나?"라고 썼다. 뒤이어 이 대통령을 향해 “야당 시절 사사건건 외교정책을 발목 잡더니 대통령 됐다고 얼굴을 싹 바꿨다. 반미친중을 중단하고 ‘어제명’부터 돌아보라”는 게시물을  올렸다. )

The day before, he posted three consecutive messages on Facebook. They included content like, "We will hold the Democratic Party regime, which injected mold vaccine into our citizens' arms, fully accountable," and "If Jeong Won-o is left in charge of Seoul's real estate, the outcome is obvious." He also offered a kind remark to Chungbuk Governor candidate Kim Young-hwan, who had said, "We must stop shaking the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership," stating, "Though your nomination came the latest, I believe you will deliver the victory report the earliest." Kim had initially been excluded (cut off) from the party primaries but, after a legal struggle, underwent a re-election and was finally confirmed as a candidate. (전날에는 페이스북에 게시물 3건을 잇달아 올렸다. “우리 국민의 팔에 곰팡이 백신을 놓은 민주당 정권에 응당한 책임을 묻겠다”, “정원오에게 서울 부동산 맡기면 결과는 뻔하다” 등의 내용이다. “장동혁 지도부를 흔드는 일을 멈춰야 한다”고 말한 김영환 충북지사 후보를 향해 “공천은 가장 늦었지만 승전보는 가장 먼저 울려주실 것으로 믿는다”고 덕담을 건넸다. 김 후보는 애초 당 경선에서 공천배제(컷오프) 됐다가 법적 투쟁 끝에 재경선을 치러 후보로 최종 결정됐다.)

Earlier, Leader Jang visited Incheon on the 6th and Yangyang County in Gangwon on the 22nd, but after hearing blunt criticisms like "The public sentiment in the capital region is in an ice age" (Rep. Yoon Sang-hyun) and "We need to solve what we have caused" (Gangwon Governor Kim Jin-tae), he has not scheduled any further public regional events. Candidates for metropolitan mayoral positions in Busan, Daegu, North Gyeongsang, Gangwon, and Sejong have appointed former Employment and Labor Minister Kim Moon-soo as honorary election committee chair. Pro-Chun faction lawmaker Jeong Seong-guk (Busan Busanjin-gu) said in an interview on SBS Radio's "Kim Tae-hyun's Political Show," "There is a judgment that Kim's joining, who has a broader supporter spectrum than Leader Jang, will be more helpful for the election." (앞서, 장 대표는 지난 6일에는 인천, 지난 22일에는 강원 양양군을 찾았다가 “수도권 민심은 빙하기 그 자체”(윤상현 의원), “결자해지가 필요하다”(김진태 강원지사) 등 ‘면전 쓴소리’를 들은 뒤 지역 공개 일정을 잡지 않고 있다. 부산·대구·경북·강원·세종 지역 광역단체장 후보들은 김문수 전 고용노동부 장관을 명예 선거대책위원장으로 내세웠다. 친한계 정성국 의원(부산 부산진갑)은 이날 에스비에스(SBS) 라디오 ‘김태현의 정치쇼’ 인터뷰에서 “장 대표보다 지지층 스펙트럼이 넓은 김 전 장관의 합류가 선거에 더 도움이 된다는 판단이 있다”고 말했다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (유영재 기자 young@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Myung-bak: "The public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end" — Meeting with Kim Eun-hye revealed (이명박 “국민, 끝까지 국힘 기대 저버리지 않을 것”…김은혜 면담 공개)
item.description:
With the People Power Party's approval rating dropping to 15% ahead of the June 3 local elections, former President Lee Myung-bak reportedly said, "The public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end," according to Rep. Kim Eun-hye, the party's senior deputy chief policymaker. (6·3 지방선거를 앞두고 국민의힘 지지율이 15%까지 떨어진 가운데 이명박 전 대통령이 “국민은 마지막까지 국민의힘에 기대를 저버리시지 않을 것”이라고 말했다고 국민의힘 원내정책수석부대표인 김은혜 의원이 전했다.)

Rep. Kim posted on Facebook on the 29th, "I went to meet with former President Lee Myung-bak." She conveyed that "former President Lee said, 'I am well aware that the party is in a difficult situation. Nevertheless, the public will not abandon their expectations for the People Power Party until the very end. Please look at reality with a cool head and run a campaign that can win the election.'" Rep. Kim revealed that she met with former President Lee for about an hour. (김 의원은 29일 페이스북에 “이명박 전 대통령을 만나 뵙고 왔다”는 글을 올렸다. 김 의원은 “(이 전 대통령이) ‘당이 어려운 상황임을 잘 알고 있다. 그럼에도 국민은 마지막까지 국민의힘에 기대를 저버리지 않을 것이다. 현실을 냉철하게 돌아보고 이기는 선거를 해달라’고 당부해줬다”고 전했다. 김 의원은 이 대통령과 한 시간 정도 만남을 가졌다고 밝혔다.)

Rep. Kim noted that a four-character idiom, "Hancheonjaku" (When the people fall into utter misery, heaven opens a path), was framed in former President Lee's office, saying, "We will recognize our shortcomings, heed only the will of the people, and approach the June 3 election with that mindset." Rep. Kim previously served as the presidential spokesperson during former President Lee's tenure. (김 의원은 “백성이 도탄에 빠지면 하늘이 길을 열어준다”는 뜻의 사자성어 ‘한천작우’가 이 전 대통령 사무실 액자 안에 담겨있었다면서 “저희의 부족함을 깨닫고, 국민의 뜻만 받들며 6·3 선거에 임하겠다”고 했다. 김 의원은 이 전 대통령 재임 당시 청와대 대변인을 지낸 바 있다.)

Indeed, the People Power Party is in a "difficult situation." According to a National Barometer Survey (NBS) released on the 23rd by Embrain Public, K-Stat Research, Korea Research, and Hankook Research (a telephone survey with a margin of error of ±3.1 percentage points at a 95% confidence level), the People Power Party's approval rating was 15%, the lowest since it changed its name to "People Power Party." Even in Daegu and North Gyeongsang Province, considered the "heart of conservatism," the Democratic Party (34%) surpassed the People Power Party (25%). The survey was conducted from the 20th to the 22nd among 1,005 people aged 18 or older. For more details, refer to the website of the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission. (실제 국민의힘은 “어려운 상황”에 처해있다. 지난 23일 엠브레인퍼블릭·케이스탯리서치·코리아리서치·한국리서치가 공개한 전국지표조사(NBS) 결과(전화면접조사, 표본오차는 95% 신뢰수준에 ±3.1%포인트)를 보면, 국민의힘 지지율은 15%로 ‘국민의힘’으로 이름을 바꾼 뒤 최저치를 기록했다. ‘보수의 심장’ 대구·경북에서도 민주당(34%)이 국민의힘(25%)을 앞서는 결과가 나왔다. 해당 조사는 지난 20∼22일 만 18살 이상 국민 1005명을 대상으로 진행됐다. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의원회 누리집을 참고하면 된다.)

Earlier, former President Lee held his first interview since leaving office with the JoongAng Ilbo last month, delivering sharp criticism to conservative forces torn between "Yoon Again" and "Cutting ties with Yoon" (breaking off relations with former President Yoon). At the time, former President Lee stated, "A conservative party that suffered a crushing defeat should look to the future—does it make sense to be divided over former President Yoon, who is already in the past?" He added, "Leave the judgment on former President Yoon to the law, and the opposition party should present a vision that the public can accept and move forward toward the future." (앞서 이 전 대통령은 지난달 중앙일보와 퇴임 뒤 첫 인터뷰를 진행하며 ‘윤 어게인’과 ‘절윤’(윤 전 대통령과의 절연) 사이에서 갈등을 빚고 있는 보수 세력을 향해 쓴소리를 한 바 있다. 당시 이 전 대통령은 “참패한 보수가 미래를 보고 나가야지 이미 지나간 과거인 윤 전 대통령을 가지고 갈라져 있다는 게 말이 되나”라며 “윤 전 대통령에 대한 판단은 법에 맡기고, 야당은 국민이 납득할 수 있는 비전을 제시하고 미래를 향해 나아가야 한다”고 했다.)

item.title: Should We Call 'North Korea' 'Joseon'?… Vice Minister of Unification "A Name That Respects the Other Is Necessary" (‘북한’을 ‘조선’이라 부를까…통일부 차관 “상대 존중하는 호칭 필요”)
item.description:
A academic conference that brings the issue of referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (Joseon), into public debate was held under the sponsorship of the Ministry of Unification. (북한을 정식 국호인 ‘조선민주주의인민공화국(조선)’으로 호칭하는 문제를 공론화하는 학술회의가 통일부 후원으로 열렸다.)

The Korean Political Science Association held a special academic conference on the 29th at the Seoul Press Center under the theme "Naming for Peaceful Coexistence: North Korea or Joseon?" In a congratulatory speech, Vice Minister of Unification Kim Nam-joong said, "When language that acknowledges and respects the reality of the other side is institutionally supported, we can break the vicious cycle of confrontation and broaden the space for peaceful coexistence." (한국정치학회는 29일 서울 프레스센터에서 ‘평화 공존을 위한 이름 부르기: 북한인가 조선인가'를 주제로 특별학술회의를 열었다. 김남중 통일부 차관은 이날 축사에서 “상대의 실체를 인정하고 존중하는 언어가 제도적으로 뒷받침될 때 대결의 악순환을 끊고 평화 공존의 공간을 넓혀갈 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Professor Kim Seong-kyung of Sogang University stated that 'North Korea' is "a non-neutral term layered with hostility, threat, and disgust within the context of the National Security Law and anti-communist ideology since 1950," and added, "Calling it by its official name can convey a message of mutual respect, a willingness to reset relations, and proactive trust-building toward North Korea." (김성경 서강대 교수는 ‘북한'은 “1950년 이후 국가보안법·반공 이데올로기의 맥락 속에서 적대와 위협, 혐오가 겹겹이 쌓인 비중립적 용어”라며 “정식 국호로 호명하는 것이 북한을 향해 상호 존중 의사와 관계 재설정 의지, 선제적 신뢰 구축 메시지를 전달할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Regarding the criticism that using the name 'Joseon' conflicts with Articles 3 and 4 of the Constitution, which define the entire Korean Peninsula as the territory and aim for peaceful unification, lawyer Kwon Eun-min (PhD in North Korean Studies) offered an interpretation that "under international law, the 'use of an official name' does not automatically connect to state recognition or the establishment of diplomatic relations." Furthermore, he said, "The territorial clause (Article 3 of the Constitution) can be interpreted as a declaratory provision that indicates the scope of the territory of a unified Korea after peaceful unification is achieved." (‘조선’ 호칭이 한반도 전체를 영토로 규정하고 평화통일을 지향하는 헌법 제3·4조와 충돌한다는 지적에 대해 권은민 변호사(북한학 박사)는 “국제법상 ‘정식 국호 사용'이 국가 승인 또는 외교관계 수립과 자동 연결되지 않는다”는 해석을 내놨다. 또, “(헌법 3조) 영토조항은 평화통일이 실현된 통일한국의 영역 범위를 의미하는 선언적 규정으로 해석 가능하다”고 했다.)

Professor Lee Dong-ki of Kangwon National University noted, "In the 1960s, West Germany abandoned the West-centric designation for East Germany in the context of overcoming hostility and pursuing reconciliation and cooperation," and argued, "A shift to naming aimed at removing the toxins of mutual hostility is necessary." (이동기 강원대 교수는 “1960년대 서독이 적대의 극복과 화해협력 맥락에서 서독 중심의 동독 호칭을 포기했다”며 “상호 간 적대성 독소 제거를 위한 이름짓기로 전환할 필요가 있다”고 했다.)

Regarding the use of the name 'Joseon,' there is a debate between claims that it is necessary to reflect changes in mutual perceptions between the two Koreas and ease tensions, and counterarguments that it is an unconstitutional claim that acknowledges North Korea's 'two-state claim' and abandons unification. Many point out that public opinion should be carefully gathered, and a formal stance should be reached not only by the Ministry of Unification but through intense discussion and deliberation across the entire government. Vice Minister Kim stated, "The government will not rush into officially referring to North Korea by its formal name," and added, "Constitutional order, the特殊性 of inter-Korean relations, domestic legislation, international practices, and national consensus must all be comprehensively considered." (‘조선’ 호칭 사용에 대해서는 남북한의 상호 인식 변화를 반영하고 긴장 완화를 위해 필요하다는 주장과 북한의 ‘두개의 국가 주장’을 인정하고 통일을 포기하는 위헌적 주장이라는 반론이 맞선다. 신중하게 여론을 수렴하고 통일부만이 아니라 정부 전체의 치열한 논의와 숙고를 거쳐 공식 입장을 내놓아야 한다는 지적이 많다. 김 차관은 “정부가 북한의 공식 국호 표기·호명을 서두르지는 않을 것이라며 “헌법적 질서, 남북관계의 특수성, 국내 법제, 국제 관행, 국민적 공감대가 종합적으로 고려돼야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Won Oh-jung “Will drastically shorten housing redevelopment project period to within 10 years” (정원오 “주택 정비사업 기간 10년 안으로 대폭 단축할 것”)
item.description:
On the 29th, Democratic Party candidate Won Oh-jung pledged to ease regulations and improve project feasibility for housing redevelopment projects, including reconstruction and redevelopment, drastically reducing the current period of around 15 years to within 10 years. (정원오 더불어민주당 후보가 29일 재건축·재개발 등 주택 정비사업의 규제를 완화하고 사업성을 개선해 지금 15년 안팎인 주택 정비사업 기간을 10년 안으로 대폭 단축하겠다고 공약했다.)

After inspecting the Jangwi-14 housing redevelopment zone in Seongbuk-gu, Seoul, on the same day, Candidate Won announced a real estate policy named "Swift Development," emphasizing speed. ( 정 후보는 이날 서울 성북구 장위14주택 재개발구역을 둘러본 뒤 속도를 강조한 ‘착착개발’이라는 이름의 부동산 정책을 발표했다. )

Candidate Won stated, "We will closely support the entire process from the start of redevelopment to moving in to accelerate development," and added, "To significantly improve the project feasibility that determines the success or failure of redevelopment projects, we will push for deregulation. We will expand areas with floor area ratio benefits to semi-industrial zones and raise the standard for calculating rental housing prices to reduce union losses." ( 정 후보는 “정비사업 시작부터 입주까지 전 과정을 밀착 지원해 개발 속도를 높이겠다”며 “정비사업 성패를 가르는 사업성을 대폭 개선하기 위해 규제 완화를 추진하겠다. 용적률 특혜 지역을 준공업지역으로 확대하고, 임대주택 가격 산정 기준을 올려 조합 손실을 줄이겠다”고 말했다. )

Candidate Won also promised to dispatch verification teams from the Seoul Housing and Communities Corporation (SH) or the Korea Real Estate Board to redevelopment areas to quickly resolve construction cost disputes. Candidate Won’s team explained, "This pledge was made in recognition that construction cost disputes are a major cause of prolonged redevelopment projects." Candidate Won also proposed transferring the authority to designate small-scale redevelopment zones under 500 households from the Seoul Metropolitan Government to local district offices. ( 정 후보는 서울주택도시개발공사(SH) 또는 한국부동산원 등의 검증단을 정비사업 지역에 파견해 공사비 분쟁을 신속히 해결하겠다고 약속했다. 정 후보 쪽은 “공사비 분쟁이 정비 사업 장기화의 주범이라는 데 주목해 만든 공약”이라고 설명했다. 정 후보는 500세대 미만 소규모 정비구역 지정 권한은 서울시에서 저치구로 이양하겠다는 공약도 내놨다. )

Additionally, Candidate Won unveiled a plan to supply 32,000 housing units early in downtown Seoul. To realize this plan, he stated he would expedite the start of construction on national and public land, military base sites, and actively pursue deregulation of aged permanent rental housing, public buildings, railway sites, and school sites. ( 정 후보는 서울 도심에 3만2천 가구를 조기에 공급하겠다는 계획도 공개했다. 계획 실현을 위해 정 후보는 국공유지·군부대 부지 등에서 공사를 조기 시작하고, 노후 영구임대주택·공공청사·철도부지·학교용지 규제 완화를 적극적으로 추진하겠다고 했다. )

Candidate Won also criticized the housing supply performance of Oh Se-hoon, the People Power Party’s candidate for Seoul mayor, saying, "During the Oh Se-hoon and Yoon Seok-yol administrations, the supply of apartments and townhouses in Seoul sharply declined, with the number of permits from 2022 to 2024 being only 62% of the previous 10 years." ( 정 후보는 “오 시장과 윤석열 정부 시기 서울의 아파트·빌라 공급 물량이 급격히 줄어 2022∼2024년 인허가 건수가 직전 10년 대비 62%에 불과하다”며 오세훈 국민의힘 서울시장 후보의 주택 공급 실적을 비판하기도 했다. )

By Choi Ha-yan chy@hani.co.kr ( 최하얀 기자 chy@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 14 Districts Confirmed for June 3 'Mini General Election' National Assembly By-elections... 13 Democratic Party Districts (‘미니 총선’ 6·3 국회의원 재보선 14곳 확정…민주 지역구 13곳)
item.description:
The National Assembly by-elections, held alongside the June 3 local elections, will take place in 14 locations nationwide. This marks the first nationwide election one year into the establishment of the Lee Jae-myung administration and following the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk-yeol. The Democratic Party anticipates a 'landslide victory' in this election, which is akin to a mini general election, while the People Power Party hopes for success in the Yeongnam region. (6·3 지방선거와 함께 치러지는 국회의원 재보궐선거가 전국 14곳에서 실시된다. 이재명 정부 출범 1년 만이자, 윤석열 전 대통령 탄핵 뒤 처음 치러지는 전국 단위 선거다. 더불어민주당은 미니 총선급인 이번 선거에서 ‘압승’을, 국민의힘은 영남 지역 승리를 기대한다.)

Members of the National Assembly confirmed as candidates for the local elections' metropolitan mayoral and gubernatorial races—Democratic Party lawmakers Choo Mi-ae (Gyeonggi Hanam Gap), Park Chan-dae (Incheon Yeonsu Gap), Wi Seong-gon (Jeju Seogwipo), Jeon Jae-soo (Busan Buk Gap), Min Hyeong-bae (Gwangju Gwangsan-eul), Park Soo-hyun (Chungnam Gongju·Buyeo·Cheongyang), Lee Won-taek (Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-eul), Kim Sang-wook (Ulsan Nam Gap) and People Power Party lawmaker Choo Kyung-ho (Daegu Dalseong)—resigned from their parliamentary seats on the 29th. (지방선거 광역자치단체장 후보로 확정된 민주당 추미애(경기 하남갑)·박찬대(인천 연수갑)·위성곤(제주 서귀포)·전재수(부산 북갑)·민형배(광주 광산을)·박수현(충남 공주·부여·청양)·이원택(전북 군산·김제·부안을)·김상욱(울산 남갑) 의원과 국민의힘 추경호(대구 달성) 의원은 29일 의원직에서 사퇴했다.)

The districts of President Lee Jae-myung and Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik—Incheon Gyeyang-eul and Chungnam Asan-eul—were confirmed early as by-election districts. Additionally, three districts including Gyeonggi Ansan Gap, Pyeongtaek-eul, and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-gap will hold re-elections after Democratic Party lawmakers received sentences nullifying their election victories. Among the 14 districts, elections will be held in 13, excluding Daegu Dalseong, due to the resignations and loss of seats of Democratic Party lawmakers. (이재명 대통령과 강훈식 대통령비서실장 지역구였던 인천 계양을과 충남 아산을은 보궐선거 지역으로 일찌감치 확정됐고, 경기 안산갑과 평택을, 전북 군산·김제·부안갑 등 3곳은 민주당 의원이 당선 무효형을 받으며 재선거를 치른다. 14개 지역구 가운데 대구 달성을 뺀 13곳이 민주당 의원들의 의원직 사퇴와 상실로 인해 선거가 열린다.)

The Democratic Party has completed nominations for six districts: Incheon Yeonsu Gap (Song Young-gil), Incheon Gyeyang-eul (Kim Nam-joon), Gyeonggi Hanam Gap (Lee Kwang-jae), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Nam-guk), Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Kim Yong-nam), and Ulsan Nam Gap (Jeon Tae-jin). Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI and future planning at the Blue House, and Jeon Eun-soo, former Blue House spokesperson, who attended the Democratic Party's talent recruitment ceremony on the same day, are confirmed to run in the Busan Buk Gap and Chungnam Asan-eul by-elections, respectively. The People Power Party has only confirmed nominations for four districts: Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Yoo Eui-dong), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Seok-hoon), Chungnam Asan-eul (Kim Min-kyung), and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan-gap (Oh Ji-seong). Cho Kook, leader of the Cho Kook Innovation Party, is running in the Pyeongtaek-eul re-election, while former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, expelled from the party, has entered the Busan Buk Gap by-election. (민주당은 인천 연수갑(송영길), 인천 계양을(김남준), 경기 하남갑(이광재), 경기 안산갑(김남국), 경기 평택을(김용남), 울산 남갑(전태진) 등 6곳의 공천을 마무리했다. 이날 민주당에서 인재영입식을 한 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석과 전은수 전 청와대 대변인은 각각 부산 북갑과 충남 아산을 보궐선거 출마가 확정적이다. 국민의힘은 경기 평택을(유의동)·경기 안산갑(김석훈)·충남 아산을(김민경)·전북 군산·김제·부안갑(오지성) 등 4곳의 공천만 확정했다. 조국 조국혁신당 대표는 경기 평택을 재선거에 국민의힘에서 제명된 한동훈 전 대표는 부산 북갑 보궐선거에 나섰다.)

A Democratic Party official stated, "Winning in all districts is our natural goal." A People Power Party official remarked, "Conditions are not favorable, but we hope for a last-minute consolidation of our support base." (민주당 관계자는 “전 지역구에서 승리하는 게 당연한 목표”라고 말했다. 국민의힘 관계자는 “여건이 좋진 않지만 막판 지지층 결집을 기대한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee: “Even if we disagree on domestic issues, I hope we maintain a ‘public stance’ on foreign relations” (이 대통령 “국내 문제 다투더라도 대외 관계엔 ‘공적 입장’ 가져줬으면”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung said on the 29th during a meeting with non-negotiating group lawmakers and independents at the National Assembly, “I hope we can take a public stance when viewing foreign relations.” This is interpreted as a call for bipartisan cooperation amid the economic crisis from the prolonged Israel-Iran war and security and economic pressures from the United States. (이재명 대통령이 29일 국회 비교섭단체, 무소속 의원들과 만나 “대외 관계를 바라볼 때 입장을 공적으로 가져주면 좋겠다”고 말했다. 이스라엘-이란 전쟁 장기화로 인한 경제 위기와 미국의 안보·경제 압박에 대한 초당적 협력을 당부한 것으로 풀이된다.)

President Lee invited Seo Wang-jin, floor leader of the Fatherland Innovation Party; Yoon Jong-o, floor leader of the Progressive Party; Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party; Han Chang-min, leader and floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, along with their members, and independent lawmakers Kim Jong-min and Choe Hyuk-jin, to the presidential office for a luncheon meeting. This marks the first time President Lee has invited all non-negotiating group lawmakers, including independents, to meet. (이 대통령은 이날 서왕진 조국혁신당 원내대표, 윤종오 진보당 원내대표, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표, 한창민 사회민주당 대표 겸 원내대표를 포함한 소속 의원들과 무소속 김종민·최혁진 의원을 청와대로 초청해 오찬 간담회를 했다. 이 대통령이 무소속을 포함한 비교섭단체 의원 모두를 초청해 만난 것은 처음이다.)

President Lee said, “Domestic circumstances have been very chaotic, but we can overcome them with our own strength. However, when external conditions deteriorate, it’s not easy to solve those issues with our own strength alone,” adding, “Looking at cases in other countries, even if we disagree and argue over domestic issues, it’s hard to find examples of self-harming behavior in external matters like diplomacy and security. Unfortunately, it seems such elements still remain somewhat within us.” President Lee’s remarks appear to emphasize the need for bipartisan cooperation without exacerbating crises and conflicts like the People Power Party, particularly amid recent energy crises and pressure from the U.S., including restrictions on some North Korea-related intelligence and demands to halt investigations into Coupang. He added, “This isn’t to say that those present here are the case. I believe the public will want politics to demonstrate its capacity for unity to overcome crisis situations,” and “Foreign affairs should be centered on national interests, regardless of political polarization.” (이 대통령은 “국내 상황도 매우 혼란스러웠지만, 우리 자신의 힘으로 이겨나갈 수 있다. 그러나 대외 환경이 악화하는 문제는 우리만의 힘으로 해결하기가 쉽지 않다”며 “다른 나라의 사례를 봐도 국내 문제에는 의견이 달라 다투더라도, 외교·안보 등 대외 문제에서 자해적 행위를 하는 경우는 찾기 쉽지 않다. 아쉽게도 우리 안에는 그런 요소들이 조금은 남아 있는 것 같다”고 말했다. 이 대통령의 언급은 최근 에너지 위기와 미국의 일부 대북 정보 제한과 쿠팡 수사 중단 요구 등 압박이 있는 상황에서 국민의힘처럼 위기와 갈등을 키우지 말고 초당적 협력을 하자는 점을 강조한 것으로 보인다. 이 대통령은 “여기 계신 분들이 그렇다는 말씀은 전혀 아니다. 국민께서는 위기 상황을 극복하기 위해 정치가 통합의 역량을 발휘해주기를 바라실 것 같다”며 “외교 관련 사안은 정치 양극화와 무관하게 국익을 중심으로 둬야 한다”고 덧붙였다.)

Non-negotiating group and independent lawmakers made several proposals to President Lee. Fatherland Innovation Party floor leader Seo Wang-jin, who ran for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek, requested converting the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support, which includes development plans following the relocation of U.S. military bases, from a temporary law to a permanent one. Progressive Party floor leader Yoon Jong-o called for reforming the long-term holding special deduction, which undermines tax equity and causes “property lock-in.” Reform Party floor leader Cheon Ha-ram requested promoting a state liability system for teacher lawsuits. Social Democratic Party leader and floor leader Han Chang-min asked for resolution of issues regarding Coupang’s violations of labor rights. (비교섭단체와 무소속 의원들은 이 대통령에게 여러 제안을 했다. 조국 대표가 6·3 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 혁신당 서왕진 원내대표는 주한미군기지 이전에 따른 개발계획을 담은 평택지원특별법을 한시법이 아닌 상시법으로 전환해달라고 요청했다. 윤종오 진보당 원내대표는 조세 형평성을 훼손하고 ‘매물 잠김’을 초래하는 장기보유특별공제 개편을, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 교사 소송 국가책임제 추진을 요청했다. 한창민 사회민주당 당대표 겸 원내대표는 쿠팡의 노동권 훼손 문제 해결을 요청했다.)

Cheong Wa Dae spokesperson Kang Yu-jung described the luncheon meeting as “a move reflecting President Lee’s inclusive communication will,” and said, “(President Lee) expressed gratitude, stating that ‘non-negotiating groups are playing a lubricating role in the dual-party-dominated political soil of polarization.’” (강유정 청와대 대변인은 오찬 간담회에 대해 “이 대통령의 포용적인 소통 의지를 담은 행보”라며 “( 이 대통령이) ‘양당 중심 양극화 정치 토양에서 비교섭단체들이 윤활유 역할을 해주고 있다’고 감사를 표했다”고 전했다.)

Reporter Goh Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (고경주 기자 goh@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Grade 5 civil servants to shift to competitive system of 'open recruitment, fast-track promotion, and private sector open positions' (5급 공무원, ‘공채·승진 패스트트랙·민간개방형’ 경쟁 체제로 바꾼다)
item.description:
On the 29th, the presidential office announced a plan to strengthen public service capabilities, introducing a 'fast-track promotion for grade 5 expert civil servants' and fostering 'expert civil servants.' (청와대가 29일 전문가 공무원 ‘5급 승진 패스트트랙’을 도입하고 ‘전문가 공무원’을 양성하는 ‘공직 역량 강화 방안’을 발표했다.)

Presidential Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik said in a briefing at the presidential office, "By introducing a fast-track promotion system for grade 5, we will enable capable individuals to quickly grow into managers," adding, "After thorough verification, they will be promoted early, starting with 100 people this year and gradually expanding." (강훈식 대통령비서실장은 이날 청와대 브리핑에서 “5급 승진 패스트트랙을 도입해 역량 있는 사람은 빠르게 관리자로 성장시키겠다”며 “철저한 검증을 거쳐 조기 승진시키는 것으로, 올해 100명을 시작으로 단계적으로 확대할 계획”이라고 말했다.)

Additionally, the government announced plans to cultivate expert civil servants in fields such as artificial intelligence (AI), trade, and labor supervision. Chief Kang stated, "In areas like AI, trade, and labor supervision, we will allow long-term service of over seven years to build expertise and provide regular training," noting, "In particular, civil servants related to AI will work across ministries without barriers, such as the Ministry of Science and ICT and the Ministry of the Interior and Safety." Currently, under the rotation system, civil servants change positions every one to two years, but this will be changed to strengthen expertise. To foster expert civil servants, 700 general civil servants will be converted to expert roles this year, with a target of securing at least 1,200 by 2028. <<> To secure outstanding private sector talent, 'open positions' will also be gradually expanded. As of January last year, open positions at the director and deputy director levels accounted for 7.1%, with a plan to increase this to 12% by 2030. According to the plan, salary caps will be abolished for certain positions, and employment restrictions will be relaxed. Senior Presidential Secretary for Personnel Management Cho Seong-joo said, "The intent of the system is to have individuals entering through three tracks—existing grade 5 open recruitment, fast-track promotion recipients, and grade 5 hiring from private sector career professionals—compete within government ministries." <<> Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (아울러 인공지능(AI), 통상, 노동감독 등 전문가 공무원을 양성하겠다고 밝혔다. 강 실장은 “에이아이, 통상, 노동감독 등의 분야는 7년 이상 장기 재직해서 실력을 쌓을 수 있게 하고 주기적으로 교육하겠다”며 “특히 인공지능 관련 공무원은 과학기술정보통신부, 행정안전부 등 부처 칸막이 없이 일하도록 하겠다”고 말했다. 현재는 공무원은 순환보직 제도에 따라 1~2년이 지나면 보직을 바꾸는데 이를 바꿔 전문성을 강화하겠다는 것이다. 전문가 공무원 양성을 위해 올해 일반직 공무원 700명을 전문가 공무원으로 전환해 2028년까지 1200명 이상 확보하기로 했다.)

item.title: Revised 'Pro-Japanese Property Recovery Act' Passes Judiciary Subcommittee... New Investigation Committee's Term Set at Minimum 3 Years (‘친일재산환수법’ 개정안 법사위 소위 통과…새 조사위 임기 최소 3년)
item.description:
A revised bill of the 'Special Act on the State Appropriation of Properties of Pro-Japanese Anti-National Actors,' which aims to recover properties of pro-Japanese anti-national actors to the state, was passed on the 29th by the Legislative Review Subcommittee 1 of the National Assembly's Legislation and Judiciary Committee through an agreement between the ruling and opposition parties. (친일 반민족 행위자의 재산을 국가에 환수하는 내용을 담은 ‘친일반민족행위자 재산의 국가귀속에 관한 특별법' 개정안이 29일 국회 법제사법위원회 법안심사1소위원회에서 여야 합의로 처리됐다.)

Kim Yong-min, Chair of the Legislative Review Subcommittee 1, met with reporters after the subcommittee review and explained, "The revised bill is a law that restarts the Pro-Japanese Property Investigation Committee, which had its term expired in 2010, as a separate entity." (김용민 법안심사1소위원장은 이날 소위 심사 뒤 기자들을 만나 “개정안은 지난 2010년 임기가 만료된 친일재산조사위원회를 별도로 다시 시작하는 법”이라고 설명했다.)

The revised bill was prepared to address the gap left after the 'Pro-Japanese Anti-National Actor Property Investigation Committee,' established in 2006, was disbanded in 2010 due to its four-year limited activity period, leaving no legal body to identify pro-Japanese assets. This is because the current law lacks clear mandatory provisions to recover profits or trace concealed properties, even in cases where descendants of pro-Japanese collaborators sell assets to third parties for cash or divide ownership. (개정안은 지난 2006년 설치된 ‘친일 반민족 행위자 재산 조사위원회'의 활동 기간이 4년으로 한정돼 2010년 해산된 이후 친일 재산을 찾아낼 법적 기구가 없는 점을 보완하고자 마련됐다. 친일파 후손들이 재산을 제3자에게 매각해 현금화하거나 소유권을 나누는 상황이 발생하더라도 수익금을 환수하거나 은닉 재산을 추적할 수 있는 명확한 강제 규정이 현행법에 명시돼 있지 않기 때문이다.)

Chair Kim stated, "Partially accommodating the People Power Party's view that the first investigation committee had already conducted sufficient investigations, we agreed to set the new investigation committee's term at three years, with a possibility of a two-year extension, and processed it accordingly." (김 위원장은 “이미 1기 조사위에서 충분히 조사를 진행했다는 국민의힘 의견을 일부 수용해, 새 조사위 임기를 3년으로 하되 2년 더 연장할 수 있도록 합의해 처리했다”고 말했다.)

Meanwhile, the revised 'Special Act on Expediting Litigation, etc.' also passed the Judiciary Subcommittee on the same day. It includes provisions allowing trials to proceed, and sometimes even verdicts to be delivered, when defendants in cases with relatively low statutory penalties fail to appear without justifiable reasons. (한편, ‘소송촉진 등에 관한 특례법' 개정안도 이날 법사위 소위를 통과했다. 법정형이 높지 않은 일부 사건들의 경우 피고인이 정당한 사유 없이 불출석했을 때에도 재판을 진행할 수 있고 때로는 선고까지 할 수 있도록 하는 내용을 담고 있다.)

However, the proposed Class Action Act, which had a public hearing on the 22nd, failed to clear the subcommittee due to disagreements between the ruling and opposition parties. The Democratic Party of Korea insists on applying the Class Action Act retroactively to cases from three years ago and adopting an 'opt-out' system, where individuals are automatically included in a class action unless they explicitly state their exclusion. Chair Kim said, "The People Power Party seems to have not yet clearly formulated its position," adding, "We are in a stage of open discussion, listening to concerns from the business community and reflecting what can be incorporated." (다만 지난 22일 공청회를 열었던 집단소송법 제정안은 여야 이견으로 소위 문턱을 넘지 못했다. 더불어민주당은 3년 전 사건에 대해서도 집단소송법을 소급 적용하고, 집단소송에서 별도로 제외 의사를 밝히지 않으면 자동으로 소송에 포함되는 ‘옵트아웃'(opt-out) 방식을 적용해야 한다는 입장이다. 김 위원장은 “국민의힘은 아직 명확하게 입장 정리가 되지 않은 것 같다”며 “재계 우려 등에 대해 충분히 경청하고 반영할 것이 있으면 반영하는 등 열어놓고 논의하는 단계”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry on Japanese ship passing through Hormuz: "Actively seeking solutions to break the current deadlock" (외교부, 일본 선박 호르무즈 통과에 “상황 타개 방안 적극 모색”)
item.description:
Regarding a Japanese oil tanker that passed through the Strait of Hormuz with permission from Iranian authorities, the Foreign Ministry stated on the 29th that it is exploring ways for ships related to South Korea to pass through as well. (일본 유조선 한 척이 이란 당국의 허가를 받아 호르무즈해협을 통과한 데 대해 외교부는 한국 관련 선박들의 통과를 위한 방안을 찾고 있다고 29일 밝혔다.)

A Foreign Ministry official said on the same day, "Based on our fundamental position, the government is actively seeking measures to overcome the current situation, including consultations between the South Korean and Iranian governments." He added, "We are communicating and cooperating with relevant countries from multiple angles, while also considering the safety of ships and the positions of shipping companies." The government emphasizes as its fundamental stance that, in accordance with relevant international norms, free navigation and safety guarantees for ships of all countries, including South Korea, in the Strait of Hormuz must be achieved promptly. (외교부 당국자는 이날 “정부는 기본 입장 하에 한국-이란 정부 간 협의를 포함해 현 상황 타개를 위한 방안을 적극 모색해 나가고 있다”고 말했다. 또, “선박의 안전과 선박회사 입장도 고려하면서 관련국들과 다각적으로 소통·협력하고 있다”고 덧붙였다. 정부는 관련 국제규범 등에 따라 호르무즈 해협 내 한국을 포함한 모든 나라 선박에 대한 자유로운 항행과 안전 보장이 조속히 이뤄져야 한다는 것을 기본 입장으로 강조하고 있다.)

According to Iranian media and the ship tracking service MarineTraffic, a Panama-flagged very large crude carrier (VLCC) owned by Japanese company Idemitsu Kosan, the *Idemitsu*, left the Strait of Hormuz the previous day with permission from Iranian authorities, loaded with 2 million barrels of crude oil. Japanese media, citing a senior government official, reported that "no passage fee was paid for the strait, and this is a result of government negotiations." It also appears that prior consultations were held with the United States, which continues to enforce a counter-blockade. While intergovernmental diplomatic negotiations are important for ship passage, it is understood that the final decision to pass, given the highly unstable situation in the strait, rests with the shipping company. (이란 매체와 선박 추적 서비스 마린트래픽 등에 따르면, 일본 회사 이데미쓰고산 소유 파나마 선적의 초대형 원유 운반선(VLCC) 이데미쓰호가 전날 원유 200만배럴을 싣고 이란 당국의 허가를 받아 호르무즈 해협을 빠져나왔다. 일본 언론들은 정부 고위 관계자를 인용해 “해협 통행료를 내지 않았고 정부가 협상한 성과”라고 전했다. 또, 역봉쇄를 계속하고 있는 미국과도 사전 협의가 이뤄졌던 것으로 보인다. 선박 통과는 정부간 외교 협상도 중요하지만, 해협이 극도로 불안정한 상황이라 통과하겠다는 최종 판단은 선사가 하는 것으로 알려졌다.)

Approximately 40 Japanese ships remain in the Strait of Hormuz, and three had previously left earlier this month. Regarding this passage, the Iranian Embassy in Japan stated that "the long-standing ties between Japan and Iran played a role." In the 1950s, when the Iranian government declared the nationalization of its oil industry and faced a maritime blockade from Britain, the founder of Idemitsu Kosan took a risk and secretly sent the *Nissho* to import Iranian crude oil. Since then, the relationship between Japan, which lacks oil resources, and Iran, which needs stable buyers, has been maintained for over 70 years. (호르무즈해협에는 일본 선박 40여척이 머무르고 있는데 이달 초에도 3척이 빠져나온 적이 있다. 이번 선박 통과에는 “일본과 이란의 오래된 인연이 작용했다”고 주일본이란대사관이 밝히기도 했다. 1950년대 이란 정부가 석유 산업 국유화를 선언했다가 영국으로부터 해상 봉쇄를 당했고, 당시 이데미쓰고산 창업자가 위험을 무릅쓰고 비밀리에 닛쇼호를 보내 이란 원유를 수입한 바 있다. 이후 석유 자원이 부족한 일본과 안정적 구매자가 필요한 이란의 관계는 70년 넘게 유지돼왔다.)

After the US-Israel-Iran war, 26 ships related to South Korea remain in the Strait of Hormuz. South Korea sent a special envoy from the Foreign Ministry to Iran and held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, but no concrete results, such as ship passage, have been achieved yet. item.title: Personnel reshuffle for minister-level officials and North Korea desk at the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. amid mounting bilateral challenges (한·미 산적한 과제 속 주미대사관 공사급·북미라인 교체)
item.description:
As challenges between South Korea and the United States pile up—including restrictions on sharing North Korea-related intelligence, the Coupang conflict, and delays in security sector negotiations—the Ministry of Foreign Affairs has initiated a personnel reshuffle involving minister-level officials at the South Korean Embassy in the U.S. and the North America desk. <<> According to a diplomatic source on the 29th, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs plans to replace the economic minister and the public diplomacy minister at the Washington embassy. Kim Sun-young, Director General for Bilateral Economic Affairs, has been appointed as the new economic minister, and Yoon Joo-seok, Director General for Consular Safety, as the new public diplomacy minister, with both expected to assume their posts next month. Current Economic Minister Ahn Se-ryung and Public Diplomacy Minister Kim Hak-jo are reportedly returning to work at the ministry's headquarters. <<> The position of political minister at the embassy, which has been vacant for several months, is expected to be filled soon. After the previous political minister was reassigned to another diplomatic post, the public diplomacy minister had been concurrently handling political minister duties. There has also been controversy over whether the Washington embassy responded adequately while Coupang, after causing a customer information leak, turned the issue into one of "discrimination against American companies" through lobbying in Washington, escalating it into a major diplomatic problem between the two countries. <<> In addition, the Director General for North American Affairs at the ministry's headquarters, responsible for U.S. affairs, is also set to be replaced soon. This means that both the ministry's headquarters and the embassy in the U.S. will see simultaneous changes in those handling U.S. diplomacy. This "renewal reshuffle" draws attention as it comes amid numerous pending issues between South Korea and the U.S. However, there is also the aspect that, as ministry personnel changes have continuously been delayed even after the new government took office, overdue reshuffles are occurring all at once, far beyond the usual tenure periods. A ministry official stated, "It's just that those who have served beyond their standard terms are included in the reshuffle, changing according to a natural personnel cycle, so there's no need to attach excessive significance by linking it to the South Korea-U.S. relationship." <<> Park Min-hee, Senior Reporter minggu@hani.co.kr (한미간에 대북 정보 공유 제한, 쿠팡 갈등, 안보 분야 협상 지연 등 과제가 쌓이고 있는 가운데 외교부가 주미대사관 공사들과 북미 라인을 교체하는 인사에 나섰다.)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo and Han Dong-hoon Embrace at Gupo Market… "Fighting" "Let's Do This Productively" (하정우·한동훈, 구포시장서 포옹…“파이팅” “생산적으로 해봅시다”)
item.description:
Ha Jung-woo, former presidential secretary for AI future strategy, who officially declared his candidacy for the June 3 by-election in Busan's Buk-gu district, and Han Dong-hoon, former leader of the People Power Party, embraced at Busan's Gupo Market on the 29th. (6·3 국회의원 재보궐선거 부산 북갑 출마를 공식화한 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석과 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표가 29일 부산 구포시장에서 포옹했다.)

The former secretary Ha and former leader Han crossed paths while touring Gupo Market in Buk-gu, Busan, that afternoon. Former Secretary Ha greeted former leader Han, saying, "You need to stay healthy. Fighting!" Han replied, "Let's do this productively." To this, former Secretary Ha responded, "Yes, constructively and progressively, together," and former leader Han added, "Great. Take care of your health." (하 전 수석과 한 전 대표는 이날 오후 부산 북구 구포시장을 돌다가 마주쳤다. 하 전 수석은 한 전 대표에게 “건강하셔야 합니다. 파이팅입니다”라고 인사했고, 한 전 대표는 “생산적으로 한 번 해봅시다”라고 답했다. 이에 하 전 수석은 “네, 건설적으로 발전적으로 같이”라고 했고, 한 전 대표도 “좋습니다. 건강 챙기세요”라고 말했다.)

During the 20-second encounter, former leader Han remarked, "It's been a while. You seem a bit thinner," to which former Secretary Ha laughed and said, "I gained weight, but then work got tough." Former leader Han patted former Secretary Ha on the shoulder, and the two shook hands. The previous day, the two candidates had engaged in a war of words on social media, with Han asking, "Did the president order you to run?" and Ha replying, "I persuaded the boss." For the People Power Party's candidate in the Busan Buk-gu by-election, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs Park Min-shik is being mentioned, and there are also calls within the party for "no nomination." (20초간 만남에서 한 전 대표가 “오랜만에 뵙네요. 좀 마르신 것 같다”고 하자, 하 전 수석은 “살이 쪘다가 일이 빡세서”라며 웃기도 했다. 한 전 대표가 하 전 수석의 어깨를 두드리거나 두 사람이 손을 맞잡기도 했다. 두 후보는 전날 에스엔에스(SNS)를 통해 “대통령이 출마를 지시했냐”(한 후보), “내가 통님을 설득했다”(하 후보) 등 신경전을 벌였다. 부산 북갑 보궐선거 국민의힘 후보로는 박민식 전 국가보훈처 장관 등이 거론되며, 국민의힘 내에서 ‘무공천’ 주장도 나오고 있다.)

By Jang Na-rae, Reporter wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.description:
The re-elections and by-elections for National Assembly seats held alongside the June 3 local elections have been finalized at 14 locations on the 29th. As the scale grows to ‘mini general election level,’ competition among candidates from each party has intensified. In particular, the Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul district, where candidates including Kim Yong-nam of the Democratic Party, Yoo Eui-dong of the People Power Party, Cho Kuk of the Fatherland Innovation Party, Kim Jae-yeon of the Progressive Party, and Hwang Kyo-ahn of the Liberty and Innovation Party are running, forming a five-way race, is considered a ‘hot spot’ in this by-election. item.title: Minister Jeong Dong-young on opposition's impeachment motion: "Are you U.S. congressmen? Your worship of America is excessive" (정동영 장관, 야당 해임건의안에 “미 의원이냐…숭미 너무 지나쳐”)
item.description:
Unification Minister Jeong Dong-young said on the 29th, addressing the opposition party that proposed an impeachment motion against him, "On security matters, their worship of America seems far too excessive." (정동영 통일부 장관이 자신의 해임건의안을 발의한 야당을 향해 “안보 사안에 대해 숭미가 너무 지나친 것 같다”고 29일 말했다.)

Minister Jeong made these remarks to reporters after attending the '3rd 2030 Youth Advisory Group Inauguration Ceremony and Minister-Youth Dialogue' held at the Odusan Unification Observatory in Gyeonggi Province. He stated, "It is in the national interest to say that the U.S.'s restrictions on sharing North Korea-related information are forced, inappropriate, and should be lifted quickly." (정 장관은 이날 경기도 오두산통일전망대에서 열린 ‘제3기 2030청년자문단 발대식 및 장관-청년 대화’에 참석한 뒤 기자들과 만나 “미국의 (대북) 정보 공유 제한이 억지스럽다, ‘안 맞다’ ‘빨리 풀라’고 말하는 것이 국익”이라며 이렇게 말했다.)

On the 24th, the People Power Party submitted an impeachment motion to the National Assembly, claiming that the recent U.S. restrictions on sharing North Korea-related information were due to Minister Jeong's remarks about a nuclear facility in Gangseong, North Korea. Minister Jeong had previously mentioned during his confirmation hearing in July last year and at the National Assembly's Foreign Affairs and Unification Committee on March 6 that there is a uranium enrichment facility in Gangseong, North Korea. (지난 24일 국민의힘은 최근 미국의 대북 정보 공유 제한의 원인이 정 장관의 북한 구성시 핵시설 발언 때문이라며 국회에 해임건의안을 제출했다. 정 장관은 지난해 7월 장관 인사청문회와 지난 3월6일 국회 외교통일위원회 당시 북한 구성시에 우라늄 농축시설이 있다고 발언한 바 있다.)

In response, Minister Jeong criticized the opposition party on this day, saying, "When the U.S. raised an issue, they panicked and started making a fuss. Are you U.S. congressmen? Members of the Korean National Assembly represent the people and must represent the national interest. They should handle (the information-sharing restrictions) in a bipartisan manner." Regarding the claim by People Power Party floor leader Song Eon-seok that pushing for public discussion to refer to North Korea by its official name, 'Joseon,' also serves as grounds for the impeachment motion, Minister Jeong said, "That is their logic, and it is not the view of the majority of the people." (이에 대해 정 장관은 이날 야당을 향해 “미국이 문제를 제기하자 화들짝, 법석을 떨기 시작했다”며 “미국 국회의원이냐. 한국 국회의원은 국민의 대표고, 국익을 대표해야 한다. (정보 공유 제한에) 초당적으로 대처해야 한다”고 비판했다. 북한을 정식 국호인 ‘조선’으로 부르자며 공론화를 추진하는 것도 해임 건의의 근거가 된다는 송언석 국민의힘 원내대표의 주장에 대해선 정 장관은 “그분들의 논리고, 국민 다수의 시각은 아니”라고 말했다.)

On a recent article in the foreign affairs magazine Foreign Affairs by Victor Cha, a Korea Chair at the Center for Strategic and International Studies (CSIS) known for his hardline stance on North Korea, Minister Jeong commented, "The (article) is a confession that the policy of complete, verifiable, and irreversible denuclearization (CVID) and sanctions-only approach has failed." He added, "For a scholar with a conservative hardline perspective to suggest removing North Korea from the list of enemies is a remarkably insightful observation." (대북 강경론자인 빅터 차 전략국제문제연구소(CSIS) 한국석좌가 최근 외교 전문지 포린어페어스에 쓴 기고문에 대해선 정 장관은 “(기고문 내용은) 완전하고 검증 가능하며 비가역적인 비핵화(CVID)와 제재 일변도 정책이 실패했다는 고백”이라며 “보수 강경 시각을 가진 학자가 북한을 적의 명단에서 빼라고 이야기한 것은 굉장히 놀라운 통찰”이라고 말했다.)

In Foreign Affairs, Victor Cha pointed out the failure of existing U.S. policy on North Korea and argued for the need for arms reduction based on acknowledging the reality of North Korea's nuclear weapons possession. Cha also said on the 28th (local time), "Focusing solely on the rhetoric of denuclearization, which has achieved nothing while North Korea continues to enhance its nuclear capabilities, is not a good way to protect the U.S.," proposing a shift in U.S. policy toward North Korea. (빅터 차 석좌는 포린어페어스에서 기존 미국의 대북 정책 실패를 지적하고, 북한의 핵무기 보유 현실을 인정하는 바탕 위에 군축의 필요성 등을 주장했다. 차 석좌는 지난 28일(현지시각)에도 “북한이 계속 핵 능력을 증강하는 동안 아무런 성과를 거두지 못한 비핵화 구호에만 집중하는 것은 미국을 보호하기 위한 좋은 방안이 아니”라며 미국의 대북 정책 전환을 제안했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: 14 by-elections ‘mini general election’… heavyweight figures’ fate gauges political realignment (재보선 14곳 ‘미니 총선’…중량급 인사 당락, 정치 재편 가늠자)
item.description:
Alongside the June 3 local elections, parliamentary by-elections will be held in 14 constituencies nationwide. This is the first nationwide election held one year after the launch of the Lee Jae-myung administration and following the impeachment of former President Yoon Suk Yeol. The Democratic Party of Korea expects a ‘landslide victory’ in these elections, which are comparable to a mini general election, while the People Power Party anticipates a win in the Yeongnam region. In particular, the outcomes for heavyweight figures, such as former Democratic Party leader Song Young-gil, Cho Kuk, leader of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party, and former People Power Party leader Han Dong-hoon, are drawing attention as they are closely tied to future internal party dynamics. <<> On the 29th, eight Democratic Party lawmakers, including Representative Choo Mi-ae (Gyeonggi Hanam Gap), who was confirmed as the party’s candidate for the metropolitan mayor in the local elections, and People Power Party Representative Choo Kyung-ho (Daegu Dalseong) resigned from their parliamentary seats. Except for Daegu Dalseong, elections are being held in 13 of the 14 constituencies due to the resignation and loss of seats by Democratic Party lawmakers. Incheon Gyeyang-eul and Chungnam Asan-eul, which were formerly constituencies of President Lee Jae-myung and Chief of Staff Kang Hoon-sik, were confirmed early as by-election districts, while three areas—Gyeonggi Ansan Gap, Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan Gap—will hold re-elections after Democratic Party lawmakers received rulings voiding their elections. <<> As of today, the Democratic Party has confirmed nominations for six constituencies: Incheon Yeonsu Gap (Song Young-gil), Incheon Gyeyang-eul (Kim Nam-jun), Gyeonggi Hanam Gap (Lee Kwang-jae), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Nam-guk), Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Kim Yong-nam), and Ulsan Nam Gap (Jeon Tae-jin). The People Power Party has only confirmed nominations for four constituencies: Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul (Yoo Eui-dong), Gyeonggi Ansan Gap (Kim Seok-hoon), Chungnam Asan-eul (Kim Min-kyung), and Jeonbuk Gunsan·Gimje·Buan Gap (Oh Ji-sung). <<> Amidst this, the victory or defeat of influential figures such as candidates Song Young-gil, Cho Kuk, and Han Dong-hoon is drawing attention. <<> Candidate Song has been strategically nominated in Incheon Yeonsu Gap. The People Power Party has yet to confirm a candidate. If Song is elected and reaches six terms, he will solidify his position as a contender for party leadership. There is also speculation about his potential candidacy in the party convention scheduled for August. Within and outside the party, there are discussions that even if Song does not run for the convention, he could serve as a focal point for the anti-Jung (anti-Jung Cheong-rae) faction in opposition to Representative Jung Cheong-rae. A pro-Lee (pro-Lee Jae-myung) senior lawmaker said, “Former leader Song’s entry into the National Assembly means one more focal point to check Representative Jung Cheong-rae (in addition to Prime Minister Kim Min-seok), which could lead to significant changes in the party’s power structure.” <<> The outcome for Cho Kuk, a candidate in Gyeonggi Pyeongtaek-eul, is directly tied to the fate of the Cho Kuk Innovation Party. If Cho triumphs in a five-way race against Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam, People Power Party candidate Yoo Eui-dong, Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon, and Freedom and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn, the Innovation Party will secure its first district lawmaker, and its merger with the Democratic Party may gain momentum after the election. However, if he loses, both his future and that of the Innovation Party become uncertain. For this reason, the Innovation Party is concentrating its efforts on the Pyeongtaek-eul election. A Democratic Party lawmaker from the metropolitan area serving a second term said, “Ahead of the 2028 general election, how much weight is given to the call for the two parties (Democratic Party and Innovation Party) to join forces depends on Cho’s success or failure in this Pyeongtaek-eul election and the subsequent public assessment.” <<> Candidate Han Dong-hoon, who has entered the race in Busan North Gap, could establish himself as a key figure in the conservative realignment process that may unfold after the election if he wins. However, he must first defeat Ha Jung-woo, a former senior presidential secretary for AI future planning, who joined the Democratic Party at an event recruiting talent. At the event in the National Assembly, Representative Jung Cheong-rae praised Ha as “a talent I was eager to recruit, beyond three visits to a humble cottage, even through thirty visits,” and Ha responded in the Busan dialect, saying, “I aim to transform from an AI designer into a practitioner. I will return to the warm embrace of my mother, sister, brother, and friends and surely achieve my vision for my hometown, Busan.” If Han Dong-hoon fails to overcome the hurdle posed by Ha, his political comeback becomes uncertain. <<> Another point of interest in this election is how well candidates from President Lee Jae-myung’s presidential office staff will perform. Ha Jung-woo and former presidential spokesperson Jeon Eun-soo, who joined the Democratic Party alongside him, are expected to run in the Chungnam Asan-eul by-election. item.title: 'Full-Color Five-Way Race' in Pyeongtaek B... "New Faces Are Tempting" "Outsiders Don't Sit Well" (‘총천연색 5파전’ 평택을…“새 인물에 솔깃” “뜨내기들 마뜩잖아”)
item.description:
"Either Candidate Yoo Ui-dong or that Kim Yong-nam guy seems fine. These days, I think elections don't really care about parties. We have to look at the person and vote." (Mr. A, in his 60s) (“유의동씨 아니면 김용남 그분도 괜찮은 거 같아. 이젠 선거라는 게 당하고 상관없는 거 같아요. 인물 위주로 보고 뽑아야죠.”(60대 ㄱ씨))

From progressives to the far-right, from party leaders to former prime ministers—a 'full-color five-way race' has formed for the June 3 by-election for the National Assembly seat in Pyeongtaek B. Citizens encountered in Pyeongtaek B on the 29th showed reactions as diverse as the election lineup. (진보부터 극우까지, 당대표부터 전 국무총리까지 ‘총천연색 5파전’ 구도가 만들어진 6·3 경기 평택을 국회의원 재선거. 29일 평택을 지역에서 만난 시민들은 선거 구도만큼이나 다양한 반응을 나타냈다.)

In Pyeongtaek B, a by-election is being held after former Democratic Party of Korea lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin, who held the district seat, had his election invalidated finalized in January. (평택을에서는 지역구 의원이었던 이병진 전 더불어민주당 의원이 지난 1월 당선무효형을 확정받으면서 재선거가 열린다.)

This district had been won by parties affiliated with the People Power Party three consecutive times from the 19th general election in 2012. It is home to Camp Humphreys, the largest overseas U.S. military base in the world. However, with the completion of Samsung Electronics' Pyeongtaek Campus factory and the development of Godeok International New Town, a large influx of young people has diluted the conservative lean. As a result, former lawmaker Lee Byeong-jin was elected in the 2024 22nd general election. (이곳은 2012년 19대 총선부터 내리 3차례 국민의힘 계열 정당이 승리했다. 이곳에는 세계 최대의 해외 미군 기지인 캠프 험프리스가 자리잡고 있다. 그러나 삼성전자 평택캠퍼스 공장 준공과 고덕국제신도시 개발로 젊은이들이 대거 유입되면서 보수세가 희석됐다. 그 결과 2024년 22대 총선에서 이병진 전 의원이 당선됐다.)

The Democratic Party has put forward former lawmaker Kim Yong-nam, who was part of a conservative party until last year, to target centrist and conservative sentiment, while the People Power Party strategically nominated former lawmaker Yoo Ui-dong, who has already served three terms in Pyeongtaek B. Jo Kuk, leader of the Rebuilding Korea Party, has entered the race, as has Kim Jae-yeon, co-chair of the Progressive Party, along with Hwang Kyo-ahn, leader of the Freedom and Innovation Party. (민주당은 지난해까지 보수 정당에 몸담았던 김용남 전 의원을 후보로 내세워 중도·보수 민심을 공략하려 하고, 국민의힘은 이미 평택을에서 3선을 한 유의동 전 의원을 전략공천했다. 조국혁신당에서는 조국 대표가, 진보당에서는 김재연 상임대표가 나섰고, 황교안 자유와혁신 대표도 뛰고 있다.)

So far, no candidate has emerged as a standout in this district. (이곳에서는 아직 어느 후보도 두각을 나타내지 못하고 있다.)

According to a poll released today by 'Yeoronjochat' (surveyed on the 26th-27th, wireless automated response method), Democratic Party candidate Kim Yong-nam received 27.5%, Rebuilding Korea Party candidate Jo Kuk 21.8%, and People Power Party candidate Yoo Ui-dong 18.9%. The support rates for Freedom and Innovation candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn (10.3%) and Progressive Party candidate Kim Jae-yeon (6.9%) are also not negligible. In a poll released on the 27th by the Korea Society Opinion Institute (KSOI), candidate Jo had 23.4%, Kim Yong-nam 21.4%, and Yoo 21.2% (surveyed on the 25th-26th, wireless automated response method. For details, refer to the National Election Survey Deliberation Commission website). (이날 ‘여론조사꽃’ 발표(지난 26~27일 조사, 무선 자동응답 방식)를 보면 김용남 민주당 후보는 27.5%, 조국 조국혁신당 후보 21.8%, 유의동 국민의힘 후보는 18.9%로 나타났다. 황교안 자유와혁신 후보(10.3%)와 김재연 진보당 후보(6.9%)의 지지율도 무시할 수 없는 수준이다. 지난 27일 발표된 한국사회여론연구소(KSOI) 조사에선 조 후보가 23.4%, 김용남 후보가 21.4%, 유 후보가 21.2%였다.(지난 25~26일 조사, 무선 자동응답 방식. 자세한 내용은 중앙선거여론조사심의위원회 누리집 참조))

'Native' Yoo Ui-dong, 'Ruling Party' Kim Yong-nam, or 'Personality Politics' Jo Kuk? (‘토박이’ 유의동이냐, ‘여당’ 김용남이냐, “인물론” 조국이냐)

One of the key issues in the election is that candidate Yoo Ui-dong, who has already served three terms in Pyeongtaek B, is the only native of Pyeongtaek. To overcome this, candidate Kim Yong-nam is emphasizing being "a ruling party candidate who will align with the capable Lee Jae-myung administration," while candidate Jo Kuk is stressing "personality politics." (선거 쟁점 중 하나는 이미 평택을에서 3선을 한 유의동 후보가 유일한 평택 출신이라는 점이다. 이를 넘어서기 위해 김용남 후보는 “일 잘하는 이재명 정부와 발맞출 여당 후보”를, 조국 후보는 “인물론”을 강조하고 있다.)

Citizen reactions were mixed. At the Rodeo Street in Anjeong-ri, Paengseong-eup, a conservative-leaning area, a woman in her 60s who has run a general store for 40 years, said, "People who aren't even from Pyeongtaek are all jumping in. Honestly, it feels like they see Pyeongtaek as a pushover, and it doesn't sit well with me," predicting an advantage for Yoo. However, Lee Gyeong-suk (61), who runs a second-hand clothing store, said, "Whether you're a native or not doesn't matter at all. It's an era where we vote based on ability these days. If the president does well, the people under him inevitably do well too. Kim Yong-nam candidate will create synergy." (시민들 반응은 다양했다. 보수 우세 지역인 팽성읍 안정리 로데오거리에서 40년 동안 잡화점을 해온 60대 여성 ㄱ씨는 “평택 출신도 아닌 사람들이 너도나도 들어오는 게, 솔직히 ‘평택을 호구로 아나’ 싶어 기분이 좋진 않다”며 유 후보의 우위를 점쳤다. 하지만 구제 옷가게를 하는 이경숙(61)씨는 “토박이냐 아니냐는 전혀 상관없다. 지금은 능력을 보고 뽑는 시대”라며 “대통령이 잘하면 그 밑에 있는 사람들도 잘할 수밖에 없다. 김용남 후보가 시너지가 날 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reactions to candidate Jo, who advocates "personality politics," were mixed. Lee said, "He also put a lot of effort into the impeachment issue and seemed sincere. I think he'll do a good job," but Son Nam-ju (30), who lives in Godeok International New Town, said, "I don't know about others, but with Jo Kuk, there's the controversy over his children's school admissions scandal, and doesn't he not even really know this area?" (“인물론”을 내세운 조 후보에 대한 반응은 엇갈렸다. 이씨는 “그분도 탄핵 때 노력을 많이 했던 분이고, 진실성 있어 보였다. 일을 잘할 거라 본다”고 했지만, 고덕국제신도시에 사는 손남주(30)씨는 “다른 사람은 모르겠는데 조국은 자녀 입시 비리 논란도 그렇고, 애초에 이 지역도 잘 모르지 않나”라고 말했다.)

However, some citizens felt skeptical about established politics due to long-unresolved local issues. Jang Hye-suk (60), who has run a mobile phone store for 24 years in Anjung-eup, said, "Local development has been practically nonexistent, so honestly, I have no expectations no matter who comes." There were also signs that 'new faces' could exploit this gap. Mr. A said, "My son in his 30s gave a good evaluation of candidate Kim Jae-yeon. It seems young people also think well of a new face like candidate Kim." (그러나 오랫동안 해결되지 않는 지역 현안 때문에 기성 정치에 회의감을 느끼는 시민들도 있었다. 안중읍에서 24년째 휴대전화 판매점을 운영하고 있는 장혜숙(60)씨는 “그동안 지역 발전이 거의 없다시피 해서 솔직히 누가 나와도 기대가 없다”고 했다. 그 틈을 ‘새 인물’이 파고들 여지도 엿보였다. ㄱ씨는 “30대인 아들이 김재연 후보를 좋게 평가하더라. 젊은 청년들은 새 인물인 김 후보도 좋게 생각하는 것 같다”고 말했다.)

Few individuals mentioned candidate Hwang Kyo-ahn. However, Kim (69), a resident of Poseung-eup who said he supports the pro-Han Dong-hoon faction within the People Power Party, remarked, "Hwang Kyo-ahn is no good. Hwang teamed up with Go Seong-guk and messed up the country. He just keeps shouting about election fraud, leading the country to this state." (황교안 후보에 대해서는 언급하는 인사가 적었다. 다만 국민의힘 내 친한동훈계를 지지한다고 밝힌 포승읍에 사는 김아무개(69)씨는 “황교안씨는 안 된다. 고성국이하고 손잡고 나라 개판 만들어놓은 게 황교안”이라며 “맨 부정선거만 외쳐서 나라가 이 꼴이 됐다”고 말했다.)

'Five-Way Race' Chaos, Possibility of Last-Minute Unification (‘5파전’ 난전, 막판 단일화 가능성도)

Given the close battle where progressive and conservative candidates struggle to gain an edge, the 'last-minute unification' possibility remains open. (진보와 보수 후보들이 우열을 가리기 힘든 접전을 벌이는 만큼 ‘막판 단일화’ 가능성도 여전히 열려 있다.)

In an interview on YouTube's 'Kim Eo-jun's Humility is Hard News Factory,' candidate Jo said regarding the possibility of unification with Kim Yong-nam, "It's always open," and added, "I think unification talks will only come up around May 21st, the start of the election campaign." Candidate Kim Yong-nam also left the door open, telling The Hankyoreh, "It's too early to discuss unification now, but if I sense that sentiment might shift toward the conservative side, I'll start discussions then." (조 후보는 유튜브 ‘김어준의 겸손은힘들다 뉴스공장’ 인터뷰에서 김용남 후보와의 단일화 가능성에 관해 “항상 열려 있다”며 “선거운동 개시일인 5월21일쯤 돼야 단일화 이야기가 비로소 나오지 않을까 생각한다”고 했다. 김용남 후보도 한겨레에 “지금 단일화 논의를 하긴 이르지만, 상황을 봐서 보수 쪽으로 세가 넘어갈 것 같다 싶으면 그때 가서 논의를 시작해 볼 것”이라고 가능성을 열어놨다.)

Citizens responded with "we'll watch the situation." Park (68), a Democratic Party supporter who has run a self-employed business for over 40 years, was reserved, saying, "It seems like we'll have to watch the situation until the end to know about unification. I'm watching with my hands behind my back." (시민들은 “상황을 지켜보겠다”는 반응이다. 민주당 지지자로 40여년 자영업을 해온 박아무개(68)씨는 “단일화는 끝까지 상황을 봐야 알 것 같다. 뒷짐 지고 지켜보고 있다”며 말을 아꼈다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee: "You don't need a picture with me, right?" Cheon Ha-ram: "I'll take one." (이 대통령 “나랑 사진 찍을 필요 없죠?” 천하람 “찍을게요”)
item.description:
Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, released a photo taken with President Lee Jae-myung, their hands clasped together. (천하람 개혁신당 원내대표가 이재명 대통령과 손을 잡고 찍은 사진을 공개했다.)

Attending a luncheon with President Lee on the 29th, Floor Leader Cheon said on Facebook that afternoon: "After lunch, President Lee suggested taking one-on-one photos with each party attendee and asked, 'Floor Leader Cheon, you don't need a photo with me, right?' I replied, 'No, I'd like to take one too.'" President Lee had invited non-negotiating groups and independent lawmakers to the National Assembly for a luncheon meeting that day. (29일 이 대통령과의 오찬에 참석한 천 원내대표는 이날 오후 페이스북에서 “점심식사 끝나고 이 대통령이 각 당 참석자와 일대일로 사진을 찍자고 권하며 ‘천 대표는 나랑 사진 찍을 필요 없죠?’라고 해서 ‘아닙니다. 저도 같이 찍겠습니다’라고 답했다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이날 국회 비교섭단체, 무소속 의원들을 초청해 오찬 간담회를 가졌다.)

Floor Leader Cheon added: "Even while taking the photo, the President said, 'This photo will probably never see the light of day,' and we laughed a lot together as we posed. I believe it's the politics of the Reform Party to criticize when necessary and fight when needed, but also laugh and take photos without needing to hide it." (천 원내대표는 “대통령이 사진 찍으면서도 ‘이 사진은 영영 공개될 일 없겠네’라고 해서 함께 크게 웃으면서 사진을 찍었다”면서 “비판할 때는 하고, 싸울 때는 싸우더라도, 웃으면서 사진도 찍고 그것을 숨길 필요 없는 것이 개혁신당의 정치라고 생각한다”고 말했다.)

"Though we are the opposition, we won't avoid meeting the President and will speak candidly," Floor Leader Cheon said. "When pointing out issues, we'll do so precisely, and when cooperating, we'll actively prioritize the national interest." He added, "When extreme supporters from both sides and a noisy minority ruin Korean politics, the Reform Party will pursue politics that please the quiet majority. We will protect the lives of that quiet majority." (천 원내대표는 “야당이지만 대통령과 만나는 것을 피하지 않고, 허심탄회하게 대화하겠다”며 “지적할 때는 정확하게 지적하고, 협업할 때는 적극적으로 국익을 우선하겠다”고 했다. 이어 “양 극단의 강성 지지층, 시끄러운 소수가 한국 정치를 망칠 때 개혁신당은 조용한 다수가 보기에 흐뭇한 정치를 하겠다”며 “조용한 다수의 삶을 지키겠다”고 덧붙였다.)

That day, President Lee invited to the presidential office floor leaders Seo Wang-jin of the Fatherland Innovation Party, Yoon Jong-o of the Progressive Party, Cheon Ha-ram of the Reform Party, and Han Chang-min, leader and floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, along with their fellow lawmakers, as well as independents Kim Jong-min and Choi Hyeok-jin, for discussions. This marked the first time President Lee invited all lawmakers from non-negotiating groups, including independents, for a meeting. (이 대통령은 이날 서왕진 조국혁신당 원내대표, 윤종오 진보당 원내대표, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표, 한창민 사회민주당 대표 겸 원내대표를 포함한 소속 의원들과 무소속 김종민·최혁진 의원을 청와대로 초청해 대화를 나눴다. 이 대통령이 무소속을 포함한 비교섭단체 의원 모두를 초청해 만난 것은 이번이 처음이다.)

The non-negotiating group and independent lawmakers made several proposals to President Lee. National Assemblyman Seo Wang-jin, floor leader of the Fatherland Innovation Party, who is running for the June 3 by-election in Pyeongtaek, requested that the Special Act on Pyeongtaek Support, which includes development plans following the relocation of U.S. military bases in Korea, be converted from a temporary law to a permanent one. Yoon Jong-o, floor leader of the Progressive Party, called for reform of the long-term holding special deduction, which undermines tax equity and causes a "property lock-in" effect. Cheon Ha-ram, floor leader of the Reform Party, asked for the implementation of a state liability system for teacher lawsuits. Han Chang-min, leader and floor leader of the Social Democratic Party, requested resolution of issues related to Coupang's infringement of labor rights. (비교섭단체와 무소속 의원들은 이 대통령에게 여러 제안을 했다. 조국 대표가 6·3 평택을 국회의원 재선거에 나선 조국혁신당 서왕진 원내대표는 주한미군기지 이전에 따른 개발계획을 담은 평택지원특별법을 한시법이 아닌 상시법으로 전환해달라고 요청했다. 윤종오 진보당 원내대표는 조세 형평성을 훼손하고 ‘매물 잠김’을 초래하는 장기보유특별공제 개편을, 천하람 개혁신당 원내대표는 교사 소송 국가책임제 추진을 요청했다. 한창민 사회민주당 당대표 겸 원내대표는 쿠팡의 노동권 훼손 문제 해결을 요청했다.)

item.title: Democratic Party: "Granting authority to dismiss indictments in a special counsel for fabricated prosecutions? Not under discussion." (민주 “조작기소 특검에 공소취소권 부여? 논의하고 있지 않다”)
item.description:
<<>> The Democratic Party of Korea denied media reports on the 30th that a draft of its "Special Counsel Act for Investigating Fabricated Prosecutions," prepared as a follow-up to the National Assembly's special committee for investigating alleged fabricated prosecutions by the Yoon Suk Yeol administration's political prosecutors, includes provisions granting authority to dismiss indictments in seven cases, including the Daejang-dong and Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance cases involving leader Lee Jae-myung. The Democratic Party is considering passing the special counsel law before the June 3 local elections, following the conclusion of the special committee's activities today. ()

Jeon Yong-gi, a Democratic Party lawmaker on the special committee, appeared on MBC Radio's "Kim Jong-bae's Focus" on this day and stated, "We are not discussing the authority to dismiss indictments. Since the special committee is actually focused on a special counsel to uncover fabricated prosecutions, we believe it cannot directly include the dismissal of indictments." Earlier, one media outlet reported that the draft of the special counsel law being prepared by Democratic Party lawmakers on the special committee includes a clause in the scope of the special counsel's duties that "also covers whether to dismiss indictments in ongoing trials." <<> Regarding Prosecutor Park Sang-yong, who handled the Ssangbangwool North Korean remittance case, claiming that "the Democratic Party is pushing for a special counsel and that the special counsel would dismiss the indictment," Jeon said, "I see it as an attempt to shift the narrative to one of 'needing to prevent the dismissal of indictments.' It would be difficult to directly grant the authority to dismiss indictments." However, Jeon added, "If it comes up for discussion, there could be deliberation on maintaining indictments, but we are not reviewing the issue of dismissing indictments." Another Democratic Party official involved with the special committee also told The Hankyoreh, "It's true that the special counsel law includes provisions regarding the filing or maintenance of indictments, but the word 'dismissal of indictment' itself is not even mentioned." <<> Kim Hyun-jung, the Democratic Party's deputy floor leader for communications, met with reporters after a policy coordination meeting at the National Assembly on this day and said, "The draft of the special counsel law is currently being prepared around the special committee, and there has been no discussion or consultation with the floor regarding the preparation of the draft." Regarding the media report about "granting authority to dismiss indictments," she drew a line, stating, "Since the content has not been finalized, it is not appropriate to answer. The content of the special counsel law has not yet been determined." <<> On this day, the special committee plans to hold a plenary session to adopt the final report on the special committee's findings and discuss the referral of perjury witnesses and deposition witnesses for prosecution. Democratic Party lawmakers on the special committee will also hold a press briefing at 11 a.m. to explain the special committee's activities so far. <<> Reporter Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr ( 더불어민주당이 국회 윤석열 정권 정치검찰 조작기소 의혹 사건 진상규명 국정조사특별위원회(국조특위) 후속으로 준비하는 ‘조작기소 진상규명 특검법안’ 초안에 이재명 대통령의 대장동·쌍방울 대북송금 사건 등 7개 사건 공소를 취소할 권한을 부여하는 취지의 내용이 담겼다는 언론 보도를 30일 부인했다. 민주당은 이날 활동을 마무리하는 국조특위에 이어 6·3 지방선거 전 특검법을 통과시키는 방안을 검토하고 있다. )

item.title: Defense Ministry: "No Discussion of USFK Reduction at All" … Following Trump's Remarks on Reducing US Forces in Germany (국방부 “주한미군 감축 논의 전혀 없다”…트럼프 주독미군 감축 발언 뒤)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense stated in relation to U.S. President Donald Trump's remarks about reviewing a reduction of U.S. troops stationed in Germany, "There is absolutely no discussion between South Korea and the United States regarding a reduction of U.S. Forces Korea (USFK)." (국방부는 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 독일 주둔 미군 감축을 검토하고 있다고 언급한 것과 관련해 “한국과 미국 사이에 주한미군 감축에 대한 논의는 전혀 없다”고 밝혔다.)

At a regular briefing on the 30th, Defense Ministry spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said, "The primary mission of USFK is to maintain a robust combined defense posture alongside our military to deter and respond to North Korea's aggression and provocations." Spokesperson Jeong added, "Going forward, South Korea and the U.S. will continue to closely consult to ensure the stable stationing of USFK and strengthen the combined defense posture." (정빛나 국방부 대변인은 30일 정례브리핑에서 “주한미군의 주요 임무는 우리군과 함께 굳건한 연합방위태세를 갖춰 북한의 침략과 도발을 억제 및 대응하는 것”이라며 이렇게 말했다. 정 대변인은 “앞으로도 주한미군의 안정적 주둔과 연합방위태세 강화를 위해 한미간 긴밀히 협의해 나갈 것”이라고 말했다.)

On the 29th (local time), President Trump stated via his social media platform Truth Social, "The United States is looking into the possibility of reducing troops stationed in Germany," adding, "A decision will be made soon." President Trump has consistently raised concerns about Europe's free-riding on security, and recently expressed dissatisfaction that Germany has not actively cooperated in the U.S.-Israel-Iran war. During his first term in 2020, President Trump also announced a plan to reduce about one-third of U.S. forces in Germany—approximately 11,900 troops—but the reduction was not implemented. (트럼프 대통령은 29일(현지시각) 소셜미디어 트루스소셜을 통해 “미국은 독일에 있는 병력의 감축 가능성을 살펴보고 있다”며 “조만간 결정이 내려질 것”이라고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 유럽의 안보 무임승차를 계속 문제 삼아왔고, 최근 독일이 미국·이스라엘-이란 전쟁에 적극 협조하지 않는다며 불만을 표시해왔다. 트럼프 대통령은 집권 1기인 2020년에도 주독미군 병력 중 3분의 1가량인 1만1900명을 감축하겠다고 발표했지만 실제로는 감축되지 않았다.)

If the background to the U.S. reduction of troops in Germany stems from dissatisfaction with Germany's security free-riding and lack of cooperation in the U.S.-Iran war, there are expectations that similar reasons could lead to a reduction of USFK. In April 2008, during the early days of the Lee Myung-bak administration, South Korea and the U.S. agreed at a summit to halt the reduction of USFK and maintain it at the current level of 28,500 troops. Since then, the official size of USFK has been 28,500. According to U.S. military data, the actual number of USFK personnel fluctuates between 23,000 and 26,000 each year. (미국이 주독미군 감축에 나선 배경이 독일의 안보 무임승차와 미국-이란전쟁에 대한 비협조에 대한 불만이라면 같은 이유로 주한미군을 감축할 가능성도 제기될 수 있다는 예상이 나온다. 이명박 정부 초기인 2008년 4월 한국과 미국이 정상회담에서 주한미군 감축을 중단하고 현 수순(2만8500명)으로 유지하기로 합의한 뒤 지금까지 주한미군 규모는 공식적으로 2만8500명이다. 미군 자료를 보면 실제 주한미군 병력은 해마다 2만3~6천명 수준을 오가고 있다.)

In a recent U.S. House of Representatives hearing, U.S. Forces Korea Commander Xavier Brunson stated, "The Korean Peninsula is a key strategic location for defending the U.S. homeland and advancing U.S. interests in the region," adding, "Our forces stationed in South Korea are undergoing modernization to respond to rapidly changing strategic challenges, which is why I focus on capabilities rather than troop numbers." (제이비어 브런슨 주한미군사령관은 최근 미 하원 청문회에서 “한반도는 미국 본토를 방어하고 역내에서 미국의 이익을 증진하는 데 핵심적인 전략적 요충지”라며 “한국에 주둔한 우리 군은 급변하는 전략적 과제에 대응코자 현대화를 추진 중이며, 이는 제가 병력 숫자보다 역량에 초점을 맞추는 이유”라고 말했다.)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-chul nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Ha Jung-woo's 'Hand Shake and Wipe' Controversy... Han Dong-hoon Says "Disrespects Citizens", People Power Party Calls It "Arrogance" (하정우 ‘ 악수 뒤 손 털기’ 논란…한동훈 “시민 무시”, 국힘 “오만”)
item.description:
Conservative factions, including the People Power Party, launched a unified offensive against the apparent gesture of Ha Jung-woo, former senior presidential secretary for AI future strategies, who is virtually confirmed as the Democratic Party of Korea candidate for the Busan North Gap by-election, after he was seen wiping his hands after a handshake. (국민의힘 등 보수 진영이 더불어민주당 부산 북갑 국회의원 재보궐선거 후보로 사실상 확정된 하정우 전 청와대 에이아이(AI)미래기획수석의 악수 후 손을 터는 듯한 모습을 두고 일제히 총공세를 폈다.)

Han Dong-hoon, independent former leader of the People Power Party who declared his candidacy for Busan North Gap, wrote on Facebook on the 30th, "Is the Democratic Party thinking that ignoring the citizens of Buk-gu won't affect the overall trend?" He mentioned this after a current Democratic Party deputy spokesperson said on a broadcast that 'Ha Jung-woo's hand-wiping doesn't affect the big picture.' The previous day, after resigning from his senior role, the former senior secretary visited Gupo Market in Buk-gu for his first schedule in Busan. During this visit, footage captured him shaking hands with merchants and then rubbing his hands together or making a wiping motion. (부산 북갑 출마를 선언한 무소속 한동훈 전 국민의힘 대표는 30일 페이스북에 “북구 시민들을 무시해도 대세에 지장 없다는 것이 민주당의 생각인가”라고 적었다. 그는 민주당 현직 부대변인이 방송에서 ‘하정우 손 털기는 대세에 지장 없다’고 했다면서 이렇게 밝혔다. 전날 하 전 수석은 수석직을 사퇴한 뒤 첫 부산 일정으로 북구 구포시장을 방문했다. 이 과정에서 상인들과 악수를 한 뒤 양손을 비비거나 손을 터는 듯한 모습이 현장 영상에 잡혔다.)

Park Min-sik, former Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs and a preliminary candidate for the People Power Party in North Gap, also commented, "That deeply rooted sense of elitism and arrogance, treating residents who have built up the area their whole lives as a 'different class' that can never mix with him, unconsciously burst out." (북갑 국민의힘 예비후보인 박민식 전 국가보훈부 장관도 “평생 지역을 일궈온 주민들을 자신과는 결코 섞일 수 없는 ‘다른 부류’로 대하는 그 뿌리 깊은 선민의식과 오만함이 무의식중에 터져 나온 것”이라고 했다.)

The offensive continued in the People Power Party meeting hall. Supreme Council member Kim Jae-won stated at the Supreme Council meeting that day, "Yesterday, the former senior secretary shook hands with a few young merchants at the market and then suddenly wiped his hands as if they had gotten some filth on them," claiming, "The former senior secretary treats voters like bugs." Spokesperson Jo Yong-sool targeted him in a commentary, asking, "We can't help but ask if he wiped his hands like that even after shaking hands with powerful figures like President Lee Jae-myung and floor leader Jung Cheong-rae," adding, "Politics that mimic the aristocracy after rising in the world cannot win voters' choice." (국민의힘 회의장에서도 공세가 이어졌다. 김재원 최고위원은 이날 최고위원회의에서 “하 전 수석이 어제 시장의 젊은 상인 몇 분하고 악수하고는 갑자기 손에 무슨 오물이라도 묻은 듯이 손을 터는 장면이 있었다”며 “하 전 수석은 유권자를 벌레 취급하는 사람”이라고 주장했다. 조용술 대변인은 논평을 통해 “이재명 대통령과 정청래 대표 같은 권력자의 손을 잡은 뒤에도 그렇게 손을 닦았는지 묻지 않을 수 없다”며 “출세한 듯 귀족 흉내를 내는 정치로는 유권자의 선택을 받을 수 없다”고 겨냥했다.)

Lawmaker Kim Jae-seop said on Channel A's YouTube, "Shaking hands with residents and then wiping his hands—it was so shocking. A horrifying scene," and struck directly, "President Lee sending out someone who lacks basic political etiquette is too arrogant." Pro-Han faction lawmaker Park Jeong-hoon asked, "Even if you had to pick, did you pick someone like this?" Former Supreme Council member Kim Jong-hyuk pointed out, "If he genuinely believes he's an elite who shouldn't shake hands with market merchants, someone exceptionally clean, then he'd better stay at the Blue House, discussing only grandiose and refined matters." (김재섭 의원은 채널에이(A) 유튜브에서 “주민과 악수하고 손을 털다니 너무 충격적이었다. 끔찍한 장면”이라며 “이 대통령이 정치에 대한 기본이 갖춰지지 않은 사람을 그냥 내려보낸 건 너무 오만해 보인다”고 직격했다. 친한(친한동훈)계 박정훈 의원은 “골라도 이런 사람을 골랐나”라고, 김종혁 전 최고위원은 “스스로를 시장 상인들과는 손잡으면 안 되는 엘리트고 특별히 깨끗한 존재라는 인식을 갖고 있다면 청와대에서 거창하고 고상한 논의만 하고 있는게 낫겠다”고 지적했다.)

Reporter Jang Na-rae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)
